methodology: Derived from GCP e2-standard-4 on-demand list price (us-central1, 4 vCPU / 16 GB, $0.134/hr), split 72% compute / 28% memory — the ratio solved empirically from AWS instance pricing (see pricing_aws.json). GCP does not sell vCPU/memory separately for Compute Engine, so this split is an approximation.
